report: All three coworkers have agreed on a plan for the leaking espresso machine. They will get one repair quote, which B will chase in a small chunk of time. If the repair is affordable and straightforward, they will repair the machine; if the machine needs regular attention or the repair is not practical, they will replace it with a low-maintenance model. No one takes on ongoing upkeep, and C has no tasks. The shared issue list above is closed with all four entries resolved by this agreement.
